title: Check the live development, staging and production sites after the rollout
description: Cloud threads cannot reach the live sites, so nobody has verified them since the 2026-10-19 rollout. Done when HTTP status (and /api/health if it exists) is recorded for https://develop.chattic.us/, https://staging.chattic.us/ and https://chattic.us/, run from the Mac or another machine that can reach them, and the production web deploy (run 39246542914) is confirmed serving the smoke-test release.
